title: Urban expansion in Al Narjis district, Riyadh: October 2017 to October 2026

headline.label: of new urban fabric between 2017 and 2026

data: Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance, 10 m, tile 38RPN: scene S2A_38RPN_20171023_0_L2A (23 October 2017, processing baseline 00.01, tile cloud 0.07%) and scene S2C_38RPN_20261016_0_L2A (16 October 2026, baseline 05.13, tile cloud 0.007%), read as windows of cloud-optimised GeoTIFFs through the Earth Search STAC API (Element 84, collection sentinel-2-l2a).
method: Picked two clear scenes in the same month (October) nine years apart and read only an 11.5 × 18.7 km window (EPSG:32638) of the blue, green and red bands and the SCL layer.
SCL cloud masks were not used: the 2017 scene flags 5.9% of the district as cloud, all of it bright roofs and an airport runway in a clear scene, so a false alarm.

Urban-fabric index: local standard deviation of mean visible brightness in a 5 × 5 pixel (50 m) window, divided by its median over a 1 km² patch of undeveloped sand east of the district, which removes the calibration difference between the dates.
A pixel is built-up when the ratio is 4 or more.
limits: At 10 m, anything smaller than about 400 m² is not reliably detected. The index measures urban fabric (buildings, roads, paving and construction), not buildings alone, so the figures are neither a building count nor a roof area. Noise is about ±300 ha.
